responsibility: Declares the include-path construction API used by GCC’s preprocessing setup. It defines the four include-chain kinds, exports helpers for adding paths, splitting quote handling, registering the final chains with cpplib, querying accumulated directories, and provides the target_c_incpath hook structure through which targets inject extra pre- and post-standard include directories.
same_name_distinction: This is the declaration header for the incpath pair: it defines the include-chain kinds, the exported path-management/registering functions, and the target_c_incpath hook structure. Unlike gcc/incpath.cc, it does not manipulate or merge include paths itself; it specifies the interface for that implementation.
